desc: Curb-mounted skylight on a Florida asphalt-shingle roof with a localized split seal and light staining at the lower flashing corner, shown as a repairable existing condition.
reuse_notes: Use for leaking skylights, flashing inspections, roof water-intrusion clues, failed sealant, and repair-scope articles. It depicts a generic existing condition, never proof of a JK Prestige project or a definitive leak diagnosis.
